plain_statement.zh: 证伪边长 4.661 的单点加权击中证书
plain_statement.en: Refute weighted point piercing at side 4.661

brief.zh: 用 70 个对称轨道生成 560 个带权合法方块，逐盒核对任一点的总荷载上界。若方块总权重严格超过该上界的 17 倍，对点与方块的双重求和即推出矛盾。
brief.en: Use 70 symmetry orbits of admissible weighted squares. Check the point depth on each box and double-count incidence when the total square weight exceeds 17 times the depth bound.
